description: The user's wallet: every live card they hold, with IDs, last four digits, expiry, balance, and status, plus `vaultCards`: the user's OWN cards stored in their Agentcard vault (display fields only; a vaulted card pays through buy with an approval on the user's device (their passkey or master password) and never exposes a number). Start here to find available cards; if none are returned, call create_card. When the shared wallet is enabled, `wallet` lists every card across all connected apps and companies, each tagged with its source (kind personal/company, the issuing app, and the company where applicable); cards created by another app or company are read-only from this session: get_card_details and close_card will not work on them.
name: list_cards

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number.

preset.description: Preset summary when the card has restrictions; omit or null when unrestricted.

sandbox.description: Whether this is a test/sandbox card.

connectedAccounts.description: Read-only cards issued and managed by an organization the user is linked to.

cardholderId.description: The user's cardholder ID within the organization.

cards.description: Cards issued under this connected account.

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number.

sandbox.description: Whether this is a test/sandbox card.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization that owns these cards.

organizationName.description: Name of the organization that owns these cards.

readOnly.description: Whether these cards are read-only for the user.

count.description: Total number of cards across the user's own cards and any connected-account cards.

message.description: Human-readable list of cards (or an empty-state message).

vaultCards.description: The user's own cards stored in their Agentcard vault. Display fields only; they pay through buy with an approval on the user's device (their passkey or master password) and never expose a card number.

label.description: The user's nickname for the card, if any.

wallet.description: One-wallet view (present when the shared wallet is enabled): every LIVE card across personal and company sources, each tagged with its provenance. Closed cards are excluded; transactions carry history.

access.description: Whether THIS session can manage the card (owned) or only see it (connected = read-only here).

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number.

sandbox.description: Whether this is a test card.

app.description: OAuth client id of the app that created the card (null for first-party surfaces).

appName.description: Display name of the issuing app (null when unknown or first-party).

kind.description: personal = created on the user's own account; company = created under a company the user is connected to.
